title: Declaration of [NAME] in Support of Plaintiff's Motion to [RELIEF]

body.text: Pursuant to Wis. Stat. § 887.015, I declare the following to be true under penalty of false swearing under the law of Wisconsin.
1. I am [NAME AND RELATION TO THE MATTER] and make this declaration on personal knowledge.
2. [One evidentiary fact per numbered paragraph. Facts only. No argument, no legal conclusions, nothing you could not testify to.]
3. Attached as Exhibit A is a true and correct copy of [document], which I [received from / sent to / obtained from] [source] on [date].
Signed on the ____ day of __________, [YEAR], at [CITY], [STATE OR COUNTRY].
